review_method: Every assigned frozen title and complete local rendered ItemBody was inspected; every one of the 219 local revision-2 PNG tiles was individually opened at original resolution. Tiles are local application ItemBody/MathMarkdown SSR captures, not production-site captures.
notes: CSS uppercase technique banners are expected; raw math inside a technique banner is defective.
Wikilinks intentionally render as separate block lines in this local preview.
Capture crops overlap; no clipping defect is asserted unless the standalone tile itself shows content cut off.
Source, snapshot, HTML, manifest, and PNG SHA256 values were recomputed from current local files. No source/snapshot/HTML/tile hash drift was found.

diagram_candidates.content: Show a local boundary face ∂M with inward flow trajectories and the collar map c(p,s)=Φ_{sδ(p)}(p), with c(p,0)=p. Depict the variable positive width δ(p), the open image in M, and the inverse collar projection followed by the boundary projection r(c(p,s))=p. The width must vary with p in the schematic; it is not a claim of a constant-width global product metric.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The theorem states existence of a smooth collar and the proof constructs it explicitly from an inward-pointing vector field and a positive smooth time-width. A schematic would make the embedding and retraction maps immediately inspectable.
checks: Line 32 states every smooth manifold with boundary has a smooth collar.
Lines 48 and 50 establish the inward local flow and prohibit a return to the boundary.
Lines 54 and 56 define the positive smooth width δ, the open domain D, and the injective local-diffeomorphism flow map F.
diagram_candidates.certainty: Optional and illustrative; the proof already states the maps and conclusions precisely. No correctness defect is claimed.
